content.description:
Sync tracker for idea mqdzlo4ia8. Wakes the PM when the cto's review (mqdzppxnai) lands so they can act on the decision:

content.reason: Blocker issue mqdzppxnai transitioned to done

content.content:
Review decision landed: ACCEPT. The cto verified all 8 failures against source and split them into three deliverables by root cause (not by phase):
- (A) Bug: real IssueDetailPage code gaps (back link, ID display, inline title edit) → webapp-developer
- (B) Chore: test/impl spec drift — align e2e assertions with the actual, acceptable UI (header landmark, comments copy) → webapp-validator
- (C) Chore: flaky backend test isolation (shared-state ordering) → webapp-validator, lowest priority

Acting on the decision: marking this sync tracker done, retagging the idea as an Epic, and creating the three scoped deliverables with their full phase flows + sync trackers.
